proof.text: Unpack finiteTorConstructibleIntegral and sfIntegralConstructible. At level n+1 retain the intrinsic constructible reduction Q and its cohomological interval [a,b]. Restriction to fixed quotient scalars is an exact equivalence, so its homology remains constructible and vanishes outside [a,b].

Apply the proved fixedDerivedOrigin helper of ProEtaleConstructibleOrigin to that fixed-scalar reduction. It supplies a bounded constructible etale complex L and the comparison isomorphism. Its finite interval makes L bounded below. Apply the specified finiteCoefficientComparison to L to obtain the finite function-coefficient object F with its retained EtaleOriginWitness.

The constant-to-completion map followed by the nth completed projection is the constant quotient map, by limit.lift_π. Naturality of the sheafification unit identifies its action on each constant scalar with the lifted quotient homomorphism. The proved ringUnitLinearizeIso helper gives an identity-on-sections comparison between ordinaryFiniteRestriction followed by fixedRestriction and fixed quotient restriction followed by scalar restriction. The cFixed comparison similarly identifies restriction of F with restriction of the fixed comparison image of L.

Localize these exact functor comparisons. Compose them with the origin isomorphism and use full faithfulness of fixedRestriction to recover the integral-constant-module isomorphism. Finally compose the inverse of S.reductionEvaluation and evaluationRestriction, identifying the restricted reduction Q with the actual nth evaluation of reduction S. Package the quotient ring, quotient homomorphism, F, its retained origin, and this isomorphism as ScalarEtaleOrigin. Repeat independently for each n; no transition compatibility or common choice of origins is needed.

title: E-side origins for scalar refinement reductions
statement: For the finite-field and coefficient hypotheses of the strict scalar refinement, a coefficient calculus S and an object M in finiteTorConstructibleIntegral have, independently at every n, a ScalarEtaleOrigin over the E reduction (ev E X n) ((reduction E X S).obj M).

lean.statement: theorem scalar_refinement_origins_E (S : CoefficientDerivedSystemCalculus.{u, u} l E X) (M : DerivedCategory (scalarReductionSource l E X)) (_hM : finiteTorConstructibleIntegral l E X M) : ∀ n : ℕ, Nonempty (ScalarEtaleOrigin (ULift.{u + 1} (Padic.coefficientExtensionIntegers l E)) X ((ev (ULift.{u + 1} (Padic.coefficientExtensionIntegers l E)) X n).obj ((reduction l E X S).obj M)))
